current.text: Wagler is a rookie. The Clippers took him with the number 5 overall pick.
He is projected as the backup point guard behind Darius Garland, ninth in the Clippers rotation. He is not expected to start on opening night or play 30 minutes.
The guard group is crowded: Garland, Bradley Beal, Kris Dunn, Max Strus and Kobe Sanders. One expert projects him for about 25 minutes.
Experts say he should not be drafted in standard formats. They say a Yahoo ADP of 117 to 124 is too high and that he is more likely to finish outside the top 250 than inside the top 100.
At most he is a late stash. One expert puts him around pick 170 in 16-team leagues, which is deeper than our 144-player draft.
His rookie season is expected to be rocky. The best hope one expert gives is that he averages double-figure points.
The Clippers rotation is not settled. Ty Lue makes unusual rotation choices and then changes them. One expert expects a trial season with long rotations.
The Clippers have a good fantasy playoff schedule with 4, 3 and 4 games in weeks 19 to 21. They have only 13 back-to-backs, one of the lowest totals in the league.
Most experts expect the Clippers to be one of the weaker teams in the league.

durable.text: He is a skilled, high-IQ guard. He can pull up off screens and catch and shoot.
Athleticism is a concern. He did not dunk once at Illinois.
The newest expert view expects him to shoot very poorly and to have efficiency problems.
His play swings a lot. He looked terrible at times but also had some high-level scoring games.

note: Skip Wagler in our auction. He is valued at 0 USD on both Yahoo and ESPN, ranks around 203 to 207, and the experts see him as a backup point guard with likely efficiency problems. His projected line of about 46% FG, 1.1 threes and 4 assists has no strong category to build around. Watch the Clippers guard minutes early in the season: if Garland rests or the crowded guard group thins out, he could become a short-term waiver add, helped by a good 4-3-4 playoff schedule.
